name: ContactS
source:
--Emotions, things that we could not touch, bound us together, leading us to meet, acquaintance, and know each other......

In this game, players will follow the protagonist's view, to experience a love story between a human and a fox.

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=847926502]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
情感，那些无法触碰的事物，将我们联系在一起，让我们相遇、相识、彼此了解……

玩家将跟随主角视角，体验一段人类与狐狸之间的爱情故事。

（来源：[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=847926502]Steam Greenlight[/url]）
